# Why I walk to work

Every morning I leave the house at a quarter to eight. The walk takes
twenty-five minutes, and it is the best part of my day.

![A tree-lined street in autumn](street.jpg)

> The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
>
> — Ernest Hemingway

I used to drive. The car was faster, but I arrived *tired* and __irritable__,
and I rarely remembered the trip.  
Walking changed that. I notice the ~~traffic~~ seasons now.

## What changed

Three things, mostly:

- I sleep better.
- I think better.
- I spend less on fuel.

That's all — thanks for reading!
